Build an sf object from NAD 83 UTM zone, easting and northing columns

Source: R/bag_sf_from_utm.R
bag_sf_from_utm.Rd

Groups a plain data frame by its UTM zone column, promotes each group to sf in that zone's projected CRS, transforms every group to one geographic CRS, and binds them back together.

Usage

bag_sf_from_utm(
  dat = NULL,
  col_utm_zone = "utm_zone",
  col_easting = "easting",
  col_northing = "northing",
  crs_return = 3005
)

Arguments

dat

A data frame carrying UTM zone, easting and northing columns.

col_utm_zone

character Name of the UTM zone column.

col_easting

character Name of the easting column.

col_northing

character Name of the northing column.

crs_return

numeric EPSG code to return in. Must be valid across every zone present — not a single UTM zone's CRS. Default 3005 (BC Albers).

Value

An sf data frame in crs_return, ordered by UTM zone.

Details

crs_return must be a CRS that is valid across every zone in the data — BC Albers (3005, the default) or WGS 84 (4326), rather than one UTM zone's own CRS, because a point from zone 9 expressed in zone 11's CRS is simply wrong. An earlier version of this sentence said "must be geographic", which excluded its own default: BC Albers is projected. The property that matters is province-wide validity, not geographic versus projected, and it is not something the function can check — a UTM crs_return is accepted and gives silently wrong coordinates for every zone but one.

See also

bag_assign_utm() to write those columns onto an sf object. The two are not inverses: that one returns its input's CRS and keeps the geometry column, this one returns crs_return and names the geometry column geom.

Other coordinates: bag_assign_latlong(), bag_assign_utm()

Examples

sites <- data.frame(
  site = c("a", "b"),
  utm_zone = c(9, 10),
  easting = c(532381, 605471),
  northing = c(6039269, 6229640)
)

bag_sf_from_utm(sites)
#> Simple feature collection with 2 features and 4 fields
#> Geometry type: POINT
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 838509.7 ymin: 1058269 xmax: 1290854 ymax: 1254828
#> Projected CRS: NAD83 / BC Albers
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   site  utm_zone easting northing               geom
#> * <chr>    <dbl>   <dbl>    <dbl>        <POINT [m]>
#> 1 a            9  532381  6039269 (838509.7 1058269)
#> 2 b           10  605471  6229640  (1290854 1254828)
